# KayKit Fantasy Weapons Bits 1.0 FREE

Creator: Kay Lousberg (www.kaylousberg.com).
Source: user-supplied local pack. License: CC0; original License.txt retained.

Hub Archer `archer_tier_2` uses
`KayKit_FantasyWeaponsBits_1.0_FREE/Assets/fbx(unity)/bow_B.fbx`.
This is the reinforced bow with crystal tips, distinct from the starter bow
and Cardinal Longbow. The supplied `weapons_bits_texture.png` palette is used
by the project-created URP Lit material `M_FantasyWeaponsBits.mat`.
Only presentation-child transforms are fitted to the existing hand attachment.
Full pack retained for manual QA before dependency-based pruning.
